title: Order matters
prompt: The first value passed in goes into the first parameter, the second into the second. The starter subtracts them the wrong way round. Fix it so solve(10, 3) is 7.
starter:
func solve(a, b):
	return b - a
hints: Look at solve(10, 3): which parameter holds 10?
Swap the two names in the return line.
solution:
func solve(a, b):
	return a - b
